public.title: Longest Unique Substring
public.description: Return the length of the longest contiguous substring of text that contains no repeated character. text contains only lowercase English letters and has at most 1000 characters. Return 0 for empty text. Aim for linear time.
hints: Maintain a window of distinct characters.
On a repeat, move its left edge forward past the previous occurrence, never backward.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Track each character's latest index. Move the window start past a repeated character only when that index lies in the current window. Record the longest window. Time is O(n), space O(26).
